title: ADS-B Low Altitude Overflight Count
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=adsb:aircraft
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(altitude_ft<3000)) as low_overflights by callsign _time
| where low_overflights>0
| sort - low_overflights
description: Uses ADS-B receiver data telemetry to monitor how many low-altitude overflights happened each day in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for aircraft patterns that are more noticeable from the property, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest ADS-B receiver data data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily callsign table of low overflights.
grandmaExplanation: It records how many low-altitude overflights happened each day so you can spot aircraft patterns that are more noticeable from the property before it becomes annoying.
